atomic_cutover: One code-only change. staff_stammdaten_service.go, staff_payroll.go and staff_document_service.go leave services/users: validation, masking, audit diffs, category authority and retention are Workforce domain code, the orchestration is Workforce application code over the Workforce-owned record rows, and the staff and person rows and the audit trail are the consumer-owned ports StaffAdminSubjects and StaffAdminAudit that services/staff_admin_composition.go binds over the retained repositories, so every read and write still joins the caller's tenant transaction and fails in the repository shape the HTTP layer classifies (404 marker, 400/403/409 wording). staff_directory_service.go leaves as the users.StaffDirectory port (services/users/staff_directory_port.go) with its implementation in services/staff_membership_directory.go, embedded in the person service so no caller changes and the lookups keep returning verbatim repository results; the two student-by-teacher reads and ResolveStaffIDByAccountID stay in the person service file. staff_default_permission.go becomes a root-composition constant over securityruntime.PermissionGroupsRead. The Factory field keeps its name (StaffDocuments) and now holds the Workforce administration, so the composition surface does not grow. Missing audit wiring now fails at construction instead of at the first call.
